text:
maria: hey — quick design QA on the invite flow. noticed a weird "ghost" state when you remove a role while the invite drawer is open. keyboard focus sometimes lands behind the drawer and screenreader says nothing. steps: open org > invite > assign role > remove role quickly > tab. reproduces on chrome + VO.
allen: ugh, saw that. is it the visual ghost (UI still shows removed role) or focus ghost (tab order)?
sam: both? i can repro the visual hang where the chip disappears from the model but the DOM node is still focusable for a sec. likely focus order not updated after state change.
maria: exactly. also the SSO toggle help text is pretty cryptic — "Enforce SSO for invites". can we make copy clearer and add an inline hint instead of only tooltip?
jess: accessibility nits: 1) need aria-live region for role change confirmations (polite). 2) ensure removed items are removed from tab order immediately (tabindex=-1 or remove node). 3) announce when the drawer is opened/closed (aria-hidden updates).
allen: design idea: keep the compact role chip but change the removal animation to a 120ms fade + collapse, and during animation set aria-hidden=true so SR doesn't read stray nodes. also add a visually-hidden status message: "Role removed".
sam: implementation sketch:
```
// after remove click
chip.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')
chip.classList.add('fade-out')
setTimeout(() => chip.remove(), 150)
liveRegion.textContent = 'Removed role: Viewer'
```
But we need to make sure focus doesn't jump to body; prefer moving focus to next tabbable in the drawer.
maria: can we instead move focus to the next role or the invite button? if there are no roles left, focus should go to the role selector.
jess: yes move to next tabbable. also add role="status" on the live region so NVDA/VO prioritize it. and check with high-contrast mode for the fade timing.
allen: copy suggestion for SSO helpline: "SSO required — new users must sign in via your company's identity provider." shorter: "Require SSO for new users." we can add a learn-more link to docs.
maria: perfect. UX question: should SSO toggle live inside invite drawer or global org banner? product is leaning to drawer since it's per-invite setting. thoughts?
sam: technically it's per-org default but per-invite override exists. putting toggle in drawer makes it discoverable for the flow. but we should show a small global hint in org settings explaining default behavior.
jess: accessibility: if toggle's state affects required fields show a short inline message and use `aria-describedby` linking to that message.
maria: can someone run a quick keyboard-only pass and add test steps in the PR? target: fix on next sprint.
sam: i'll pick this up — will add unit + e2e for keyboard nav and update the chip remove sequence. pinging @allen for animation spec.
allen: i'll share a microprototype in Figma and add the aria-hidden state and live message locations.
deploy-bot: branch created: feature/invite-focus-2240 — CI started :gear:

maria: assigning: sam (eng) for patch, allen (design) for microproto + specs, jess for a11y QA. will prepare copy PR after we lock text. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
